{{Top|leg}}
'''Medium plating type 1''' was developed by engineer [[Hoot Calin]] and was designed to rely more on deflecting angles than exotic alloys. The cost was sometimes considered prohibitive, though this plating was the most affordable model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] medium plating.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
